notes: Interns work with an animal care team or a plant team. Volunteer coordinator for other teen roles: 505-848-7142.
name: ABQ BioPark High School Internship
what_you_do: A part-time paid internship on an animal care team or a plant team. You help feed animals, make toys for them and talk to guests about your area.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors ages 16 to 19.
pay_detail: $5,000 stipend, paid in two halves at week 4 and week 8
duration: 8 consecutive weeks, Monday to Thursday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (2026: June 1 to July 24)
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Mar 1 to Mar 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect March.
how_to_apply: Apply online in March. Use the BioPark internship page.
